findings.problem: Claim-94 closes a westernInterval at AD 630 (貞觀四年) citing s0086, but s0086 only summarizes Gaozu and Taizong policy outcomes and does not state 貞觀四年; the regnal endpoint appears on s0084 至四年.
findings.action: Move interval end evidence to s0084 (and s0083 framing) or narrow the interval to what s0010–s0085 jointly support.

findings.problem: Claim-96 maps 永淳以後 (s0092) to Western interval AD 682–683, but 永淳 is the era itself (682–683); 以後 means afterward, so the attestation frame should begin no earlier than AD 684, not collapse into the Yongchun years.
findings.action: Replace with westernBounds (earliest AD 684) or a post-Yongchun interval through end of Gaozong’s reign; remove the 682–683 closed interval for 永淳以後.

findings.problem: Claim-97 pins Zhangsun Wuji (p005) to AD 650 via sourceDate 高宗即位 on s0087–s0088, but those units read 高宗承之 and 太尉長孫無忌等輔政 with no accession-year marker.
findings.action: Relabel sourceDate to undated Gaozong-era service or a supported reign-span; drop the explicit westernYear 650 unless evidence adds 即位.

findings.problem: Claim-124 assigns Han Huang (p025) a point year AD 766 for 永泰二年後 on s0157/s0160, but 後 denotes after Yongtai 2 (766 itself); s0160 narrates Fifth Qi’s demotion and Han taking 判度支 afterward.
findings.action: Use westernBounds with start AD 767 (or leave undated post-766) rather than equating 永泰二年後 with the Yongtai-2 year.

findings.problem: Claim-128 caps Yuan Zai (p028) at 代宗朝 AD 763–770, yet 代宗朝 continues to 779 and Yuan remained chief minister until his execution in 777; ending at 770 imports Yu Chao’en’s 770 death from the same paragraph, not the stated frame.
findings.action: Extend the interval to the full Daizong reign (at least through AD 777–779) or mark the attestation undated on s0164 without the erroneous 770 endpoint.
